## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every issue Acceptance Criterion is satisfied with linked evidence.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All required unit, contract, integration, E2E, visual, security, and
      external/client validation passes.
- [ ] Authored code reports 100% lines, statements, functions, and branches.
- [ ] Specifications and ADRs match the implemented behavior.
- [ ] Migration, compatibility, observability, security, and rollback impacts
      are documented and tested as applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, private email addresses, generated data, or unrelated changes
      are included.
